facts.fact: 梦魇：被绑床上四肢拉开、绳越挣越紧——水从口鼻灌入溺死。
facts.anchor: the ropes only continued to pull, ratcheting tighter and tighter and tighter.

facts.fact: Claire 凌晨 4:30 呼吸衰竭——Miriam 认为某种瘫痪剂；复苏失败心跳停止。
facts.anchor: Claire started coding around four thirty a.m., respiratory failure.

facts.fact: 医院监控只有三处（门口/产科/急诊）——窗户不开。
facts.anchor: there’s one at the front entrance, there’s one in the maternity ward

facts.fact: 副手整夜守在门外、David 两点回家看孩子——都在场却没有差别。
facts.anchor: He was sitting outside the room when she died. He was there all night

facts.fact: Alex 推理：他知道我们会救活她、知道她会在医院、知道要在那里完成。
facts.anchor: He knew we’d save her. He knew that she’d be at the hospital.

facts.fact: 「第二次死亡要平和」——他要伤害的是丈夫们，不是女人。
facts.anchor: He wanted the second death to be… peaceful

facts.fact: 他可能一直在房里——我们进去时就在壁橱或浴室。
facts.anchor: He might have even been there when we went in, hiding somewhere in the room

facts.fact: Lacey 打断：他不是幽灵——是人；杀了三个还想杀第四个——Laura 还活着，我们能救她。
facts.anchor: He’s not some kind of fucking phantom. He’s just a man.

facts.fact: Alex 心里不敢出口的两个词：Can we?
